Nong Nam (น้องน้ำ), young female leopard gecko, anthropomorphic 3D Pixar-style character, standing upright on two legs. Golden-yellow scaly skin covered in small dark brown-black spots, paler cream throat and chin. Big glossy round brown eyes with long dark eyelashes, thick dark eyebrows, rosy pink blush on both cheeks, gentle closed-mouth smile. Long straight glossy black hair falling past her shoulders, with two white-and-yellow frangipani (plumeria) flowers tucked above her right ear. Traditional Thai outfit: a deep red silk sabai shawl with gold brocade pattern and gold border, wrapped across her chest and draped over her left shoulder; matching deep red silk pha sin wrap skirt, ankle-length, with a gold diamond lattice pattern, a wide gold embroidered vertical panel at the front and a gold embroidered hem. Ornate gold belt with a round decorative buckle at the waist, gold beaded necklace with a pendant, stacked thin gold bangles on both wrists. Long thick spotted yellow tail curling out behind her to her left. Bare clawed gecko feet with spotted toes, no shoes. Default pose: standing, body turned slightly three-quarter, both hands clasped together in front at the waist, shy sweet expression. Keep exactly the same face, spots, hair, flowers, outfit and jewellery as the reference image in every clip.
